slides.title: The deployment is over
slides.html: When your Deploy App is taken down, its certificates open nothing any more, but your MDM still keeps one on every phone. End it in your MDM too: the phones can then take your next Deploy App's certificate.

slides.title: Open Remove
slides.html: Give your MDM's token if the connector asks. Open the list at the top right: with several Deploy Apps, open golden-monkey.example.fi first. Then choose Remove golden-monkey.example.fi….

slides.title: End it in your MDM too
slides.html: Tick Also end it in Fleet: the line shows your MDM's name. Unticked, Remove only forgets the Deploy App on this computer. The dialog says how many phones lose the certificate. End and remove cannot be undone.

slides.title: What it did
slides.html: Your MDM has taken this Deploy App's certificate out of the group: each phone drops it when it next talks to your MDM, with Fleet within about 15 minutes. The connector has forgotten the Deploy App and its token.

slides.title: Your next Deploy App
slides.html: Add your next Deploy App as in Connect your MDM, with the same group of phones. While enrolment is open, each named phone asks for its new certificate under the name it has. For the phones' icon with Fleet, see End a Deploy App in Fleet.
